title: SAEBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Sparse Autoencoders in Language Model Interpretability

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability to remove spurious correlations between gender and professions in a linear classifier through targeted zero-ablation of sparse autoencoder (SAE) latents using the Bias in Bios dataset, as well as measuring attribute disentanglement (including gender) using the RAVEL evaluation.
